akagawa_bucket: The draft reached R-S6 on Day 7. Norbert Bucket was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Norbert Bucket (Concord) and Zeno Smiridisnick (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Blackwater Canal for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Bucket measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Norbert Bucket wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.

Clement Breadcrumb lent Norbert Bucket a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Norbert Bucket is number 468. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Norbert Bucket read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Clement Breadcrumb saw Norbert Bucket freeze up on the fire step at Blackwater Canal. Clement said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Norbert Bucket across the shin at R-S6. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Yann "Smokes" Tylen of the Hegemony (@tylen7x). A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Bucket is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A letter from home reached Norbert Bucket before dusk. Norbert Bucket read it twice and slept a little easier.
A supply man offered Norbert Bucket a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

A bullet went through Norbert Bucket's upper arm at R-S6 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Teodor "Doc" Rley of the Hegemony (@ma.rley5115). The letter for Norbert Bucket asked if the food was good. Norbert Bucket wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
royalcanadianmatt: After 9 days of war, S-C6 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Dorian Royalcanadia.

The flare went up just as Dorian Royalcanadia reached the Hegemony parapet. Dorian Royalcanadia jumped down first. Ivo Roma was the man waiting there, and Ivo Roma fell. (@vitto_roma07) Dorian Royalcanadia crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Marek "Lucky" Mateorekon reached for a rifle. Dorian Royalcanadia was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@mateorekon) The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Dorian Royalcanadia looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Dorian Royalcanadia before the night shift. Dorian Royalcanadia folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian Royalcanadia carried three men out of S-C6 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not. A letter from home found Dorian Royalcanadia before the night shift. Dorian Royalcanadia folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Dorian Royalcanadia is number 669 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Royalcanadia kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Dorian Royalcanadia sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
Dorian Royalcanadia read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Dorian Royalcanadia traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Dorian Royalcanadia gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Dorian Royalcanadia found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
t_camper_13: The sergeant gave Jakub "Shadow" Camper a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 4 or any other.
Jakub "Shadow" Camper agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F3 and grazed Jakub "Shadow" Camper's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210). The Hegemony won Hill 304. In S-F3, Jakub "Shadow" Camper listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jakub "Shadow" Camper is whole again, or near enough for the line.
The artist tried again while Jakub "Shadow" Camper read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
A bullet clipped Jakub "Shadow" Camper's helmet at S-F3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Silas Hansen of the Hegemony (@mikkel.hansen27).

A bullet went through Jakub "Shadow" Camper's upper arm at S-F3 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210). Jakub "Shadow" Camper was killed outright at S-F3, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).
Ivo Camper took the same post at S-F3 where Jakub "Shadow" Camper stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Ivo Camper watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Otto Raphoto and Ivo Camper found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Ivo. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ivo Camper answered to number 302. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Ivo Camper looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Ivo Camper worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Shell splinters peppered S-F3. Ivo Camper picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
The medic cut the last bandage off Ivo Camper's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F3 the same hour.
Ivo Camper tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Ivo Camper owes Marek Boi so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
user_procyon: Dorian Procyon joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Dorian Procyon could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Dorian Procyon fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Dorian Procyon's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through the rim of Dorian Procyon's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now.
The medic looked at Dorian Procyon's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to U-F5. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Dorian Procyon was on watch at U-F5 when the night raid hit. The men found Dorian Procyon at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord (@cody_lahetta).
The papers say Ivo Procyon. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Dorian Procyon's eyes. Nobody in U-F5 argues.
vic_jul11: Gustav "Tin" Jul found a place in S-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
One of the first hundred, Gustav "Tin" Jul was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Gustav "Tin" Jul's transfer to the role of chaplain was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
The sky stayed clear above S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched a small cloud form and quietly hoped it would bring friends.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The guns found S-F10. Gustav "Tin" Jul was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
No bed for Gustav "Tin" Jul yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.

Gustav "Tin" Jul lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Gustav "Tin" Jul did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

There was never a bed for Gustav "Tin" Jul, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F10 on his own feet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Gustav "Tin" Jul in the open at S-F10. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0). Gustav "Tin" Jul finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Gustav "Tin" Jul is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.

The stretcher Gustav "Tin" Jul lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Gustav "Tin" Jul is back at S-F10, and someone else is lying in that dent now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav "Tin" Jul reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F10 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord (@vuminhtri260709). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav "Tin" Jul no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Gustav "Tin" Jul watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav "Tin" Jul began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Gustav "Tin" Jul could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Gustav "Tin" Jul found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav "Tin" Jul. Gustav "Tin" Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav "Tin" Jul was hit in the hip at S-F10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bram Kochek of the Concord (@thicc_kochek). Gustav "Tin" Jul was killed at S-F10 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Bram Kochek of the Concord (@thicc_kochek).
Valentin Jul asked about Gustav "Tin" Jul on arriving at S-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Valentin Jul as a story about a general. The ending was the same. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin Jul. Valentin Jul read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Valentin Jul ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F10. Valentin Jul took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Marek Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06).
william_fg9: Clement William was a tailor in Lindenbruck until the posters went up. He came to T-F3 with his brother's pocket watch, and within a day the whole squad knew that he polishes his buttons every evening.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Clement William helped stack spare sandbags at T-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Clement William and Silas "Tin" Roman sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F3 with the rations. Clement William ate while listening to the revised orders.
Clement William traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Clement William's ear at T-F3 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso of the Hegemony (@spencercensor). Clement William fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F3. Gustav Tangibliciou was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Clement William walked back up the communication trench to T-F3, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Clement William fired at a movement across the wire at T-F3. The man went down: Ulrich Djsunspear, grazed.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Clement William only heard boots on the duckboards at T-F3, then nothing but pain. Raider: Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
xxcboogxx: Konrad Xxcboogxx joined the replacements on Day 13. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Albin Cor and Konrad Xxcboogxx found a cat in the ruins at the Hanging Bridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Konrad.
Konrad Xxcboogxx opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Konrad Xxcboogxx saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Isidor York, grazed.
